text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Maybe it's just me, but my skin feels a bit dry...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: (Coffee has a diuretic effect, so drinking too much can lead to dry skin...)

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Maybe I should hold back a bit.
*sigh*...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On top of having rough skin,
Manhattan Cafe felt thoroughly dejected
that she had to cut back on her beloved coffee.
